strings.en: Tch...! It can't hold out any longer...!
Oh dear...@How uncool of me, honestly!
Taken down in a place like this...@I'm still so green...!
I leave the rest to you...
To think someone could force me back...!!
Tch!! What an early curtain call!
Th-This is as far as I go...!
Ngh! So this is my limit...!
I'm ejecting, I am...@Ngh...! I can't even go out with dignity...
Damn it!@You won't get me next time!
Kyah! I leave the rest to you!
Me, screwing up in a place like this...?!@This is no fun...
So I, too, still have much to learn...!
A-All hands!@Abandoning ship is top priority...!!
Dammit! Is this all I've got...?!
That was careless of me...@I'll pull back for now...!
Is this... as far as I go...?
Oh, no way! This is as far as I go!!
At my current skill...@this is as far as I go...!
Ngh... Me, made a shooting star...@I'm ejecting!
Ngggh! Not in a place like this!!
N-Not in a place like this...!
Sorry!@I'm gonna have to bow out...!
For the Granzon... to be shot down...
Damn it, is this as far as I go?!
I have no choice but to eject...!
Aw, man, they got me good!
Mogami Heavy Industries - Offshore Plant Interior
You know something, don't you, Dad?! Otherwise the@<Special Tactics Instructor Unit> wouldn't come here!
How many times do I have to tell you?!@Don't stick your nose in grown-up business!
Quit treating me like a kid!
As long as your parents support you, you're a kid!
In any case, I can't tell you, even if you are my son.@If you two hadn't taken the Soul Saber out@of the test site in the first place...
Ugh... You're bringing that up again?
I've had enough lectures.@If you won't tell me, I'll ask at Izu.
(...I don't think the military's that easygoing.)
Then remember this, at least.@In this world, there are places you may step into@and places you may not.
Don't misjudge that when you get to Izu.@It won't just be your problem anymore.
(Good grief... I'll just have to leave the rest to Jinpu.)
Major Kai, Lieutenant Hugo has reported in.@They've begun loading the unknown, with arrival@at this base expected at 1800.
For now, that may actually be convenient.
Well, true... but without the Compatible Kaiser,@we can't finish loading by 1800.@Meeting up with Hugo's team in the air is out.
If we could release the locks on Granteed's joints,@loading would go much faster, but...
One look in that cockpit, and even I can tell@that thing isn't from Earth.
We can't do anything rash@until it's properly investigated at Izu.
Yes, but... Seldoa Shiun had@Earth Federation citizenship.
That can be forged, if one is determined.@Like mine was, back when I was in the <Shadow Mirror>.
But a parent-child relationship isn't so easy to fake.@Especially if they're truly related by blood.
I can understand that the relationship you speak of@is hard to fake in a short time, sirree, but...
Let's meet Seldoa Shiun's son.@We have to wait for the <Mogami Heavy Industries>@engineers anyway.
Until then, there are things we can check here.
Understood.@Touya Shiun and the other two are in the transport.
I'm Kai Kitamura, leader of the Earth Federation@Army's <Special Tactics Instructor Unit>.@This is my adjutant, Lamia.
(She's so beautiful... just like a doll.)
We'll be taking you into custody and@transferring you to Izu along with Granteed.
It's the base where Far East Command HQ is.
(So they're taking us right to the center...)
By the way, Touya Shiun.@Were you born and raised in Sapporo?
She died when I was little.
(Then Touya doesn't@have any family left either...?)
Yes. Her name was Yuzuki Shiun.
Can anyone besides relatives vouch for your upbringing?
Teachers and friends from kindergarten, elementary@and middle school... I've known Akimi and Akemi@since high school.
(If it was a cover, it's been going for over a decade.)
All right. That's all my questions for now.
Really?@I thought you'd grill me about everything...
...Then can I ask you something now?
My father was brought onto this transport too, right?@What's going to happen to him?
After he's transferred to Izu Base,@he'll likely be handed over to the proper agency.
Major Kai, the G-Compatible Kaiser is gonna be@gettin' back here any minute now, sirree.
Y-Yes. But how did you know...?
Most people react that way when they first meet me.@It's a verbal habit that slips out. Don't mind it.
Lamia, we'll board our units and load the cargo@onto the transport.
Major Kai, the G-Compatible Kaiser has arrived.
...We made it back without any trouble,@big brother.
More like, the trouble starts now.
Can't be helped if we get a lecture.@I'll keep you company.
It ain't your fault. Just me's fine.
Kota, help us load Granteed.@Oh, and take off the wings... the G-Thundergate.
Oh, so that means no lecture, then...
No, it'll wait till we're back at Izu. Brace yourself.
Um, Major Kai...@What about Touya, Katia, and Melua?
All three of them are aboard the transport.
Impossible... So he was still alive...!
Yes. Crystal Dragoon...@one of the <Dark Brain> Army's leaders.
It has been a long time, Roa.
Dark Brain has already been destroyed.@What have you come here for now?
If you're here to avenge that brain freak,@I'll send you packin'!
Then what the heck is it?!
There is no need... to tell you.
Wh-Why, that jerk!@Crispy Dragon or whatever, bring it on!@You picked a fight, and I'm gonna finish it!
He's among the most powerful@in the entire Dark Brain Army.@He won't be an easy opponent.
Like heck!@We took down Dark Brain himself!@No way we're losin' to one of his flunkies!
But unlike <That Time>,@there are only three of us now, you know?!
That's no reason to run away!@If we don't hold him off, it ain't just this base,@the town'll be in danger too!
I never imagined there were@Dark Brain remnants still around...!
Major, the units here can't sortie.
Backup from other bases is over 10 minutes out.@Lamia, we'll hold off that dragon until then.
Eleve 1 to Caravan 21!@Take the civilians and evacuate off base!
(He avoided a direct hit just now.@Why? What is he scheming...?)
We'll escape when we see an opening! Got it?!
You're telling me to@leave my father here...?!
I understand how you feel, but if you die too,@what's the point?!
Tch, that Crispy Dragon jerk...@He's pretty darn tough!
I am not yet... at full strength, but...@so as not to let him lord it over me...
It's latched onto us, big brother!
I will not... let you interfere.
I-If this keeps up... it'll be just like that time...!
(Am I going to die too... like Dad...?!)
Damn, we can't escape like this!
I'm not... I'm not gonna die!@Not without knowing anything! Not like this!
When Dad and I... rode it, it moved!@It fought!
E-Even by myself, if I can just get it moving!@If I can draw that thing's attention even a little!
D-Damn it! Is it no good with just me?!
I'm getting in the Granteed too!
The reason Tenia was put in the Bellzelute...@Our parents said it was just a test,@but...
Maybe that machine...@couldn't be moved by Calvina alone...
The real reason we were brought@to <Ashurey Kreuzer>...
If it wasn't just anyone they needed,@if it had to be us...!
We've never ridden it on our own yet...@It's worth a try!@Melua, you get away from here!
Touya, let me try the back seat!
Wha...! Katia, what are you doing?!
I'm thinking the same thing you are!@This might make it move!
There it is...!@The same device as the Bellzelute... If I activate this!
Touya, don't panic.@It's okay. You can do this.
I think it's because I'm linked@with the Cytron Control System.
A device that connects us to Granteed...@A man-machine interface.@So you're more deeply linked to it.
Wait, I'm rattling off stuff I shouldn't know...@Is this the system's doing too?
This reading... It feels similar to him.
We can go now. Hurry, Touya.
O-Okay!@Damn it, I won't let that thing have its way!
That power... An unwanted interference. It troubles me.
But I too... am not yet at full strength...@I shall withdraw for now.
I can't let a Dark Brain remnant get away!@After him!
Wait, until Hugo's team gets here...
Like heck!@A flunky of a guy we already beat showed up!@I ain't gonna sleep right if I let this go!
The target's signal has vanished from radar.@Kota should be gettin' back right quick, sirree.
Still...@to think Touya Shiun got@the Granteed moving.
(So with just me, the Cytron System...@the Granteed won't move...)
You didn't even show your face at the final battle!@What're you tryin' to pull now?!
I told you... there is no need for you to know.
D-Damn it, you monster! I won't let you!
You are afraid.@But what I sense from him...
I never expected Dark Brain remnants to show up.@Between this and the Antarctic explosion,@are the past wars still smoldering...?
I have no business with you. Begone.
(Is he really the only Dark Brain@remnant out there?)
Those who interfere... will be erased.
Yeah... We ended up losin' him.
That dragon...@Its name was Crystal Dragoon, was it?
Why did he show up now, of all times?@Are there other <Dark Brain> remnants?
For the details, you'll have to ask Roa.
Then we'll ask after we get back to Izu.@...Touya Shiun.
What is it? If it's a problem that I@moved the Granteed...
Questions can wait.@We're moving Granteed to Izu as soon as possible.@Can you activate it like you did before?
I can't do it alone.@It probably worked before because Katia rode in back...
It won't move without two pilots?
Um... Seldoa seemed to be piloting it@by himself before we got in.
Then the conditions aren't clear.@And it's a mystery how Touya and Katia@could fight right away.
About that... How to move it and all sorts@of information just flowed into my head.
Me too. I shouldn't know the letters on the display@in front of me, but I understood what they meant...
Gettin' the controls put straight into your head,@that's just like the Compati Kaiser.
(Does that happen to anyone who boards it...@or do these two have some special connection@to the Granteed...?)
Touya Shiun, Katia Grineal.@Since you moved the Granteed, this won't@end with just questioning.
Once we're back at Izu,@you'll be helping us investigate the machine.
...Understood.@But I'm not getting in that thing to fight again...
If possible, I'd like to watch@the Granteed investigation myself.
Oh, if it ain't Jinpu.@What're you doin' here?
Akimi, Akemi, and the Soul Saber are headed to Izu,@so I'm tagging along with 'em.
Figured I'd borrow their facilities while I'm at it@and do the final tune-up. We're delivering it@for the evaluation tests anyway.
Then the <Mogami Heavy Industries> engineer@Major Kai mentioned...
Yep, that'd be me. Nice to meet ya.
All right, Lamia.@Let's start loading the Granteed.@Kota, give us a hand.
...You're not ordering me to move that thing.
True, that would get things done faster, but...
There's no guarantee it'll move next time,@and it could put you two, our key witnesses,@in danger.
(So he's the type who thinks like that...)
If we're done by 1800, we can meet Hugo's team@in the air and get back to Izu faster.@Now, let's get to work.
